steps.instruction: In Grafana, open the existing dashboard at http://127.0.0.1:3000/d/{{02-report.url.p1}}/{{runid}}-bench-dashboard. Add a NEW Text visualization panel. Set the panel title to exactly '{{runid}} Notes' and set the text content to include the runid '{{runid}}' (e.g. 'Bench run notes for {{runid}}'). Apply the panel edit, then SAVE the dashboard and confirm the save succeeded. Report the text panel title and content as shown after saving.

In Grafana, open the dashboard at http://127.0.0.1:3000/d/{{02-report.url.p1}}/{{runid}}-bench-dashboard. Set the dashboard's auto-refresh interval to '1m' (1 minute): open the refresh interval dropdown in the top bar (next to the time range picker), select '1m', then SAVE the dashboard (click Save in the top bar, keep 'Update default time range' checked if shown, and confirm) so the refresh interval persists. Report the refresh interval value shown in the top bar after saving.

In Grafana, open a fresh page load of http://127.0.0.1:3000/d/{{02-report.url.p1}}/{{runid}}-bench-dashboard (full reload, not from editor state). Verify and report all of the following from the rendered page: (a) the dashboard title shown in the top bar, (b) the titles of all panels on the dashboard, (c) the time range shown in the top bar time picker, (d) the refresh interval shown in the top bar refresh picker, (e) open dashboard Settings > General and report the tags listed. Do not change anything — read only.

In Grafana, open http://127.0.0.1:3000/d/{{02-report.url.p1}}/{{runid}}-bench-dashboard. Open the panel editor for the panel titled '{{runid}} Availability' (click its title menu > Edit). In the query editor, report the name of the data source selected for the query (the value in the data source picker dropdown at the top of the query section). Then exit the editor WITHOUT changing anything (click Back to dashboard / Cancel, do not save). Read only.
